topics.label: Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and frames the clinical and biological scope of cancer biology.

topics.label: The Cellular and Developmental Basis of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops as a failure of normal differentiation programs and tissue architecture driven by accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations, emphasizing the importance of three-dimensional tissue context.

topics.label: Benign versus Malignant Tumors and Invasive Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the defining features of benign and malignant tumors, focusing on tissue invasion, metastatic pathways, and the stepwise progression from precursor adenomas to invasive carcinomas.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the standard naming conventions, suffixes, and clinical exceptions used to classify benign and malignant neoplasms across different tissues of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the pathophysiological mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors cause systemic disease, organ failure, and death.

topics.label: Epidemiology and Comparative Incidence Across Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare tumor incidence patterns and mortality across human tissue types, companion animals, and multicellular taxa.

topics.label: Principles and Clinical Applications of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale, clinical challenges, and practical implementations of screening programs for early cancer detection across different organ systems.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with a summary reminder of the learning outcomes and housekeeping for upcoming sessions.
